summary: Jade Biosciences (filer) disclosed the entry into a license agreement with Paragon Therapeutics. The license grants exclusive rights to develop monospecific antibodies for an undisclosed target in all human therapeutic fields. Consideration includes development and regulatory milestones of up to $22.0 million, sublicensing fees up to ~$20.1 million, and low to mid-single-digit royalties on net sales. The agreement is a standard licensing transaction, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or change of control is involved. This is a routine material definitive agreement filing.
